## Academic

Media coverage of a 2024 *JAMA Internal Medicine* study on historical redlining and delays in HIV treatment, co-authored with colleagues at UAB CFAR (see the [original article](https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2024.5003){target="_blank"} on the [Publications](publications.qmd) page).

:::
